protocol_constants.j1_cell_rule: expands >= 3 of 6 rings with EVERY expanded ring err < 6.0 mV; J1 = all 12 junction cells
protocol_constants.j4_rule: >= 8 of 12 OOD cells pass the J1 cell test (2/3 majority)
protocol_constants.discipline_rule: JUNCTION-FLIP EXCLUSION (one rule, zero knobs): no flip-active edge may sit on the cone's C<->F junction. (JD-a membership) the ring-k frontier is F_q(C) = {j not in C : exists i in C, |W_quiet[i,j]| > 0} with W_quiet = W_avg and every carrier chord edge zeroed — a node whose only committed-adjacency is a flip edge is not emitted to this ring; (JD-b window) the read window = induced subgraph on C u F_q with every carrier chord edge crossing C<->F zeroed in every frame; C-interior and F-interior flip edges stay in-window. Carrier chords = the construction's a-priori chord set (exp148 chord_set); the committed SET walk stays support-driven (on W_quiet); P2/P3/P5'/P6/P7 exp152 verbatim.
